title: Rare-earth reserves · countries and territories
reserve_basis: Total rare-earth reserves, expressed as REO equivalent; includes lanthanides and yttrium and excludes most scandium. Not individual Nd, Pr, Dy or Tb reserves.
unit: metric tonnes of rare-earth-oxide equivalent (t REO)

world_total.label: World total >75 million t REO
world_total.note: The published rounded world total is a lower bound, not an exact denominator. Country/world calculations are bounds based on the reported values, not exact global shares.

listed_subtotal.label: Share of reported country reserves total · 75.29 million t REO
listed_subtotal.note: Sum of the eleven numeric entries in this table. NA entries and unlisted countries are excluded. Percentages of this subtotal are not percentages of all global reserves; rounding of estimates limits precision. Displayed two-decimal shares sum to 99.99% through rounding; no residual Other share is invented.

countries.name: United States
notes: USGS separately reports 3.6 million tonnes of measured and indicated U.S. resources; that resource figure is not added to reserves.
countries.reserve_reference_period: Publication snapshot, revision 2026-05-27; no common country measurement date is supplied.

countries.name: Australia
notes: Footnote 13: JORC-compliant or equivalent reserves were 3.3 million tonnes. The main table uses 6.3 million; replacing it with 3.3 would change the comparison basis.

The 6.3 million tonne main-column basis is Accessible Economic Demonstrated Resources (AEDR); JORC/equivalent Ore Reserves are 3.3 million tonnes. National classifications and measurement vintages vary, so the compilation is not a harmonized reserve audit.

caveats: Reserves are economically extractable mineral stocks under the reporting framework, not yearly mine output, operating separation capacity, magnet output or inventory.
This is total-REE REO equivalent. It cannot be interpreted as individual magnet NdPr, Dy or Tb reserves or feedstock availability.
The world total is rounded and reported as >75 million. The numeric-country subtotal is 75.29 million; neither gives an exact complete global percentage distribution.
NA means not available. Countries omitted from the table remain unlisted/unknown; neither category is plotted as a measured zero.
Country/territory display anchors are geographic references, not mine coordinates or ownership records.
Reserves do not identify corporate mine control or establish a physical shipment route to the United States. Facility evidence and typed contracts remain separate map layers.
country_comparability: Same USGS global compilation, but national classifications and measurement vintages vary; not a harmonized international reserve audit.
